messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] quality_gate triggered for model redwood-rlhf-1 in production at 3123456789
incident-bot: metric: safety_fail_rate jumped from 0.5% -> 5.9% over the last 10m (sampled evals) — threshold 2.0%
incident-bot: triggering PagerDuty page: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P123456789
pagerduty-bot: Page sent to on-call: @alex (ML oncall) — incident P123456789
alex: ACK. Oncall here, grabbing context and logs. @sam please stand by for infra checks. :point_up:
sam: ACKed in PagerDuty. I'll check rollout history, infra metrics, and recent config changes.
maria: Saw a spike in customer flags (toxic/safety) and longer completions for fintech-prod tenant. CS already triaged 3 tickets.
alex: Quick triage: recent deploy at 3123456700 included new quant profile "q4_0_opt" + vocab token merge. Suspect quantization regressed safety. Initiating rollback of quant profile now:
```
redwood rollback-quant --model redwood-rlhf-1 --profile q3_1
```
ops-bot: Rollback job jb-998 submitted. Status: running. ETA ~45s.
alex: Also applying routing override to pin traffic to stable model variant (v3) while we validate:
```
rwctl route set --model redwood-rlhf-1@v3 --weight 1.0 --note "pin due to quality gate" 
```
sam: Infra checks: no GPU OOMs, latency and kv-cache hits normal. No infra-side anomalies — points to model artifact change. 
incident-bot: Rollback job jb-998 completed successfully at 3123456748.
alex: Running quick smoke eval suite against v3: `eval-run --suite quick-safety --model redwood-rlhf-1@v3` — will report results in ~2m.
incident-bot: quick-safety results: safety_fail_rate 0.9% (baseline 0.4%) — elevated but below trigger threshold and much improved vs 5.9%.
maria: Customer impact summary: 3 support tickets (SUP-9081, SUP-9083, SUP-9086), CS notified, no regulatory/PHI exposure so far. Recommend incident severity P1 until we stabilize.
jordan: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note once we confirm stabilization. Ping me when safety_fail_rate stable <1%. :writing_hand:
alex: Current mitigation summary: 1) rolled back quant profile, 2) pinned routing to stable variant, 3) smoke evals running, 4) monitoring dashboards updated. Plan: observe 1 hour; if safety_fail_rate >2% re-escalate to model team for rollback of the model binary.
sam: Setting incident severity P1 and notifying ML lead + SRE lead. Escalation path intact. @maria please confirm if any tenant contains PHI or legal/regulatory flags.
maria: Confirmed: fintech-prod impacted but no PHI. Legal loop not required right now. CS and account leads notified.
pagerduty-bot: Incident P123456789 acknowledged by alex at 3123456795. Escalation halted.
alex: Opening follow-up ticket for model team: TKT-4572 (investigate quant profile regression + add additional evals). Adding note to postmortem queue.
ops-bot: Metrics watch: safety_fail_rate trending down to 0.6% at 3123456820, sample size 2.1k prompts. Latency unchanged.
alex: +15m update: safety_fail_rate ~0.6%; customer tickets being handled by CS. Leaving routing pinned for 1 hour, then gradually revert if stable.
jordan: Drafted customer advisory; will wait for your ok to send.
alex: OK to send after 1hr if no regressions. Closing actions: create post-incident eval suite targeted at quant profiles, add a gating check to rollout pipeline, and schedule a model-team review. Will update thread with final postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
